title: For Pearl Logan, or with her
what_we_know: The post says she began in Sheridan in some relation to the madam Pearl Logan. The museum holds no record that names Pearl Logan.
what_we_dont: Whether Angie worked for her or with her.
what_might_answer_it: Sheridan license, tax and court records from 1953 on that name both women.
evidence_needed: Any record naming Pearl Logan with Angie or the Rex Hotel.
